title: main is red (post-merge gate): stock_source_holes fails after PR #2894

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Main is broken or a regression with no workaround; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
The post-merge gate on `main` is red since the merge of PR #2894 (`81407b31b`, issue #2887). The last green run was on `fd0b1e68d`.

## What fails

`app suites: stock_source_holes`, one test:

```
framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number
panicked at crates\app\tests\stock_source_holes_support\mod.rs:260:58
test result: FAILED. 8 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored
```

At that line, `generate` now refuses with the new text of PR #2894: "the edge loop near X35.000 Y20.249 carries a modelled chamfer on only part of its length ... pick the edges to break". The test expects that the operation generates, and that a later check gives the refusal with its hint.

## Evidence

- Post-merge run 44713940674 on `81407b31b`: `wall 20.1 min, 977 step(s), 1 failed`.
- Post-merge run 44718580746 on `afbf1590e`: failure.
- The local batch gate of PR #2939 (a branch that contains `81407b31b`) shows the same failed test. PR #2939 does not change this code.

## Cause, as far as known

PR #2894 added a refusal for a chamfer with no picked edges on a partly bevelled edge loop. The part of this test (a framed stock with holes) now meets that refusal. PR #2894 was merged on its author's quick gate and two reviews by reading. The batch tier did not run on the merged tree before the merge.

The work decides between these two, and records the decision:

- The new refusal is too wide for this part (the same family as #2929, a drafted side that is refused as "partly bevelled"). Then the refusal becomes narrower.
- The refusal is correct for this part. Then the test gets a part that reaches the check that it pins, and no assert becomes weaker.

## Done when

- `cargo xtask gate batch --only "app suites: stock_source_holes"` is green on `main`.
- The partly bevelled plate of #2887 is still refused.

Refs #2887, #2929
